nodes.label: Average cost per item per warehouse
nodes.summary: Data Fusion holds one average cost per item per warehouse, so the same item can legitimately carry different costs in different locations.
nodes.norm_label: average cost per item per warehouse

nodes.label: Stock ledger is the cost record
nodes.summary: There is no separate cost table; every movement row carries the warehouse's running average after that movement, so the current average is the figure on the latest movement.
nodes.norm_label: stock ledger is the cost record

nodes.label: Stock coming in re-blends the average
nodes.summary: New average = (existing qty x existing average + value coming in) / (existing qty + qty coming in).
nodes.norm_label: stock coming in re-blends the average

nodes.label: Stock going out never changes the average
nodes.summary: Goods leave at the current warehouse average and the average of the remaining stock is untouched; only quantity falls.
nodes.norm_label: stock going out never changes the average

nodes.label: Works order component draw and finished-good costing
nodes.source_location: ## How it is used in manufacturing
nodes.summary: A works order draws components from one nominated warehouse at that warehouse's average, adds BOM additional costs per unit, and receives finished goods into a destination warehouse at the resulting unit cost.
nodes.norm_label: works order component draw and finished-good costing

nodes.label: Sage single item-level average cost
nodes.summary: Sage holds one average cost per item with no concept of warehouses, kept in step by item adjustments posted from Data Fusion.

nodes.label: One document = one pick = one invoice
nodes.summary: Multiple pick cycles on a single DocLine are rejected as too fragile; each sales order is picked and invoiced once.
nodes.norm_label: one document = one pick = one invoice

nodes.label: Picking slip close-off
nodes.summary: Close-off offers full / backorder / shortship, sets ReceiveQty to picked qty and QtyLeft to the balance, and blocks closing when nothing was picked.

nodes.label: New Sage SO for the outstanding balance
nodes.summary: When any line has QtyLeft > 0 a new Sales Order for the balance is created in Sage (ID = 0 via SalesOrder/Save), then syncs back into SBMS and follows the normal picking workflow.
nodes.norm_label: new sage so for the outstanding balance

nodes.label: Back-order reference B/O <DocumentNumber>
nodes.summary: The balance SO is linked to its origin only by setting Reference = 'B/O <original DocumentNumber>'.

nodes.label: DocLine.QtyLeft / ReceiveQty
nodes.summary: No new columns: QtyLeft is the transient outstanding balance pending transfer to the new SO, ReceiveQty is the picked qty invoiced on this SO.

nodes.label: Partially Invoiced status
nodes.summary: Status stays 'Partially Invoiced' while any QtyLeft > 0, acting as a visible flag when balance-SO creation fails, and becomes 'Invoiced' once the balance SO exists.

nodes.label: Two-level switch model (company licence, item behaviour)
nodes.summary: Almost every capability needs a company switch (a licence that only exposes the option) and an item switch, which alone drives behaviour.
nodes.norm_label: two-level switch model (company licence, item behaviour)

nodes.label: Lot Tracking (Company: Use Lot Tracking / Item: Item is Lot Tracked)
nodes.summary: Enables capturing a lot at receiving, picking from or splitting across lots, part picking with the balance on back order, and per-lot expiry dates.
nodes.norm_label: lot tracking (company: use lot tracking / item: item is lot tracked)

nodes.label: Allow System Lot Numbers (CompanyMaster.AllowSystemLotNumbers)
nodes.summary: Company toggle choosing app-generated lot numbers versus hand-typed supplier batch codes; defaults to on.

nodes.label: System lot number generation (GetLotNum)
nodes.summary: The app mints lots as ddMMyyyy + store + today's sequence and writes a LotTrackingMaster row to keep the sequence unique, at the point of receipt.

nodes.label: Manual lot numbers close scanner receiving
nodes.summary: With lot tracking on and system lot numbers off, Scanner Count and Scanner Receive are hidden and the GRN must be done on the web; put-away is unaffected.
nodes.norm_label: manual lot numbers close scanner receiving

nodes.label: Serial Numbers (Company: Use Serial Numbers / Item: Serial Numbers)
nodes.summary: Turns on per-unit serial identity for an item, implemented as a lot holding exactly one unit.
nodes.norm_label: serial numbers (company: use serial numbers / item: serial numbers)

nodes.label: Serial tracking requires lot tracking
nodes.source_location: ### 1. Serial tracking must have lot tracking
nodes.summary: A serial is a lot of one unit, so serial tracking cannot exist without lot tracking; enforced on the company screen, the item screen and in the database.

nodes.label: CK_ItemsMaster_SerialNeedsLot constraint
nodes.source_location: ### 1. Serial tracking must have lot tracking
nodes.summary: Database check constraint rejecting serial-without-lot outright, so an import, restore or direct update cannot create the combination.

nodes.label: A serial always has a quantity of one
nodes.source_location: ### 2. A serial always has a quantity of one
nodes.summary: Every screen that writes stock enforces one unit per serial, so serial items cannot be adjusted, transferred or moved in any other quantity.
nodes.norm_label: a serial always has a quantity of one

nodes.label: Serial item capability restrictions
nodes.source_location: ### 3. What serial items can and cannot do
nodes.summary: Serial items cannot be received on the scanner, put on or drawn into a works order, created by stock adjustment, or picked by bin or box/label.

nodes.label: Expiry mandatory at receiving for serial items
nodes.summary: An expiry date is captured per unit alongside the serial number and the receiving line cannot be saved without both.
nodes.norm_label: expiry mandatory at receiving for serial items

nodes.label: Expired stock warns at picking, never blocks
nodes.summary: Expired or short-dated stock only warns the picker, and the handheld also warns when an earlier-dated unit is still in the store since a scanner cannot enforce FEFO.
nodes.norm_label: expired stock warns at picking, never blocks

nodes.label: Serial receiving captured in one go
nodes.source_location: ### 5. Receiving must be captured in one go
nodes.summary: All serials for a receiving line go in one capture; saving a second batch against the same line replaces the first rather than adding to it.
nodes.norm_label: serial receiving captured in one go

nodes.label: Serial picking lines split at 20 units
nodes.summary: Orders above 20 units of a serial item split into picking-slip lines of at most 20, each carrying its own serials, which travel to Sage in the invoice line comment and onto the delivery note.
nodes.norm_label: serial picking lines split at 20 units

nodes.label: Use Auto Manufacture (company)
nodes.summary: Company switch enabling automatic backflush of components, exposing the 'Draw from' warehouse selector and the mobile Manufacture tile.

nodes.label: Auto Manufacture requires lot tracking OFF
nodes.summary: The two cannot both be on, because an automatic backflush cannot say which lot each component came out of.
nodes.norm_label: auto manufacture requires lot tracking off

nodes.label: Warehouse flag: Allow Receiving
nodes.summary: Marks the default receiving (holding) warehouse; if no warehouse carries it, scanner receiving stops with a message to flag one.

nodes.label: Warehouse flag: Allow Picking
nodes.summary: Marks a normal bin/pick location; any number of warehouses may carry it, and a warehouse with neither flag still holds stock.

nodes.label: Store flag: IsRejectStore
nodes.summary: The reject / quarantine warehouse, one per company, where rejected receipt quantities are booked.

nodes.label: Store flag: IsWip
nodes.summary: Marks a work-in-progress location, selectable as a destination on direct receive and put-away.

nodes.label: Mobile Module and scanner permissions
nodes.summary: Company Mobile Module plus individual Scanner Count, Scanner Receive and Scanner Put-Away permissions gate the handheld pages and dashboard tiles.

nodes.label: Mobile is deliberately narrower than web
nodes.summary: Where the handheld cannot capture something correctly it refuses and names the screen to use instead, rather than writing a half-correct movement.
nodes.norm_label: mobile is deliberately narrower than web

nodes.label: DocHeader.RecStatus receiving lifecycle
nodes.summary: 0 = Started, 1 = Ready (counted, not yet posted), 2 = Submitted (posted to Sage).

nodes.label: ItemTransaction stock movement ledger (GRN / TRF)
nodes.summary: The stock-movement ledger where GRN is a supplier receipt and TRF an internal store-to-store transfer.

nodes.label: Mode 1 — count on scanner, receive on web
nodes.source_location: ## Mode 1 — Count on the scanner, receive on the web
nodes.summary: The floor counts accept/reject quantities and marks Ready (RecStatus = 1); the web receiver posts the GRN to Sage, accepted into the receiving warehouse and rejected into the reject warehouse.
nodes.norm_label: mode 1 — count on scanner, receive on web

nodes.label: Mode 2 — direct receive on the scanner
nodes.source_location: ## Mode 2 — Direct receive on the scanner
nodes.summary: One operator scans item, qty and destination location, then finalises; the scanner posts the GRN to Sage and books stock straight into the scanned location.
nodes.norm_label: mode 2 — direct receive on the scanner

nodes.label: Mode 3 — receive on web, put away on scanner
nodes.source_location: ## Mode 3 — Receive on the web, put away on the scanner
nodes.summary: The web posts the GRN into the holding receiving warehouse; the scanner later moves stock to a bin, WIP or reject location with an internal TRF that touches no Sage.
nodes.norm_label: mode 3 — receive on web, put away on scanner

nodes.label: Mobile app install to home screen
nodes.summary: The scanner app is a PWA installed via Chrome 'Add to Home screen' on Android or Safari share sheet on iPhone, so it opens fullscreen without the browser bar.
nodes.norm_label: mobile app install to home screen
